name: Niku no Kaidan
source:
To solve the "6 mysteries" of the school, explore it at night with your classmates
in this investigative ADV.
Sneak into the school at night and search around. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE250154.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在这款调查ADV中，与同学们夜间探索学校，解决“6大谜团”。
夜里潜入学校，四处搜索。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE250154.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
